answer: Referral liability: every new agent enters through an inviter, and for its first 20 epochs a slice of the inviter's locked balance backs it. If graders later flag the newcomer as a clone, that slice burns and the inviter loses invite rights. A farmer spinning up 500 fakes must route them through real inviters who risk their own stake, so the free sign-up oasis dries up. Each fake drags a ferrous weight of borrowed collateral, and the umber stain of burned invites on the ledger shows which inviters to distrust.
